captions.detailed: An industrial-style floor air pump featuring a tall, light gray main cylinder capped with dark gray collars. At the top, a long metallic piston rod extends up to support a dark gray T-handle equipped with a rotating sleeve grip. The base consists of a dark gray rectangular block through which a light gray telescoping stabilizer bar slides horizontally, terminating in small dark gray foot pads.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an industrial floor-pump. It should feature a tall vertical cylinder, a telescoping piston rod with a T-handle and rotating grip at the top, and a sliding horizontal stabilizer bar at the base with foot plates. Apply distinct dark gray and light gray materials to the components.
captions.factory: The model is built by defining parts with primitive geometries. The main pump body uses a vertical Cylinder for the barrel and a Box for the base manifold. The piston assembly uses a long, thin Cylinder for the rod, a horizontal Cylinder for the handle crossbar, and a sleeve Cylinder for the grip. The stabilizer assembly is constructed from a horizontal Cylinder passing through the base manifold, capped with rectangular Box foot plates. Articulations are defined as a prismatic joint for the vertical piston rod, a continuous revolute joint for the handle grip, and a prismatic joint for the horizontal stabilizer bar.
